scenarios.title: Level up puts a level counter on the permanent
decisions: A activates level up on Student of Warfare, paying {W} with a Plains.
B does not respond unless the variant says so; the ability resolves.

variants.label: one_level
variants.expected: Student of Warfare has one level counter and is still a 1/1 (level 2 has not been reached).

variants.label: two_levels
variants.delta: A activates level up a second time, paying {W} with the other Plains; it resolves.
variants.expected: Student of Warfare has two level counters and is a 3/3 with first strike.

variants.label: killed_in_response
variants.delta: In response to the activation, B casts Shock targeting Student of Warfare, tapping Mountain.
variants.expected: Shock resolves first and Student of Warfare dies (A's graveyard). The level up ability then resolves and puts no counter anywhere.

operation.unclassifiable: a different spell cast by B in response

detector.outcome: A resolution puts a level counter on a permanent, which is what a level up ability does.
detector.near_miss: Not counted: no api singles out level up's Keyword line, so only the fires side is tagged.

scenarios.title: Level up can be activated only as a sorcery
decisions: A has priority and considers activating level up ({W}) on Student of Warfare.

variants.label: main_phase_empty_stack
variants.expected: Activating level up is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: combat_step
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Level up can be activated only at sorcery timing, so activating it is not legal (can_play false).

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: B's Shock (targeting A) is on the stack and A holds priority.
variants.expected: The stack is not empty, so level up cannot be activated (can_play false).

operation.unclassifiable: adds a spell to the stack

detector.outcome: An ability restricted to sorcery timing passes the casting-speed check in its controller's main phase with an empty stack.
detector.near_miss: The candidate fails the casting-speed check outside that window.
